answer: A farm cannot pad a short template to fit, because the duplicate check runs on the padded text and the ridge band is published for each class. Since the measured length is checked against the declared class, the atlas audit records the value and keeps the rejection reason. The length band is a cap tied to the mechanism class, 186 to 265 characters here, and an answer outside it is rejected as padded or truncated before the orchard identity is graded at all.
